chapter: Louis Armstrong, Gene Krupa and the drum school
title: Not in Gene's shadow; TV appearances together

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Well did you ever feel kind of in Gene's shadow seeing that he was the drummer that they made a movie about and he was always very much (CROSSTALK)
All American. I never figured anything like that because I just admired Gene's playing.

Yeah, see, and I just went on and did my thing and he done his thing, you know, because we did several things on the Tonight Show before Johnny Carson got it—Steve Allen—we were on there and did a thing together. We were on there. Then we were on the Garry Moore show a couple of times and did a drum thing together with Garry. Gene gave Garry a whole full set of drums. We did a couple of things on there, and then we did another

Yeah, he played drums, yeah. And then we did another thing on Strike It Rich, Gene and I. And so then we did a couple of things with Timex, we were the first ones that did the Timex thing. Did several shows for Timex. But, yeah we did quite a few TV spots together.
